what_happened: Dispatch outcome #3 (stale --only-gate 1-23 cap) was independently confirmed via git log -L on verify-deploy.sh's arg-parsing block: commit 3d28b4399 (task 810 phase 4) already replaced the literal cap with a derived _only_gate_max_id from gate_registry_ids, well before this task's dispatch was authored. --only-gate 24/25 both validate correctly today. Saved an unnecessary code change; recommendation is to report this outcome as already-resolved rather than re-fixing working code.

Dispatch's CURRENT STATE claim ('table is CORRECT right now, all 21 non-core dirs have rows') is now stale: task 482 created the 'sapience' extension directory after this dispatch was authored, and never added a row for it to agent-system/extensions/README.md's Available Extensions table. Real directory count (23) minus core (22 expected) vs 21 table rows -- sapience is the one missing row. This is live drift the new lint will legitimately fail on; adding the sapience row becomes a precondition for outcome #5 (full gate set green after redeploy), not optional repair.

Two of the dispatch's REQUIRED OUTCOMES rest on invalidated facts, both re-confirmed independently during planning: (a) outcome #3's --only-gate 1-23 cap no longer exists -- verify-deploy.sh lines 381-401 derive _only_gate_max_id from gate_registry_ids with 23 only as a degraded-registry fallback, so the outcome collapses to a confirmation plus two stale prose nits; (b) the dispatch's 'CURRENT STATE: the table is CORRECT right now' claim is false -- the sapience extension directory has no Available Extensions row (23 dirs minus core = 22 expected, table has 21), so the new gate cannot be green without adding it. Plan folds both into Phase 1 and Phase 4 rather than treating either as out of scope.

Dispatch's CURRENT STATE claim (table correct, all 21 non-core rows present) was invalidated during planning: the sapience extension directory had no table row (23 dirs minus core = 22 expected rows vs 21 actual). Repaired in Phase 1 by adding the missing sapience row; no dangling rows found.
